description: Rafhan Maize Products Company Limited is a Pakistani maize processor that supplies sweeteners to the country's confectionery, bakery, dairy and ice-cream, and beverage industries. The company states that introducing spring maize production technology was a milestone that set the stage for Pakistan to become self-sufficient in maize, and that it works with the SAI Platform on sustainable and regenerative agriculture standards.
sourceNote: Company website (rafhanmaize.com: home, products), read 2026-10-17. No registered office or telephone number is published on the pages read.
